confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, beer, cocktail and wine anchors rest on 2026-dated but mostly commercial or crowdsourced price pages that disagree by up to about 2x. Cocktail and wine are partly inferred from beer and Aperol Spritz price points. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season and were not checked against live listings. FX: the rate given is the most recent rba.gov.au value I could verify (20 March 2026, seen in search results). It is not the latest available on 2026-11-19. A later 27 October 2026 figure appeared only on a third-party site and was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Sicilian regional capital. Food and drink anchors are based on 2026 Palermo price-comparison pages (Expatistan, whereandwhen and similar), a June 2026 Euronews/eurochange Aperol Spritz index, and regional price reporting. EUR prices were converted to USD at about 1.14 USD per EUR, the rate implied by conversions on the cited pages. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic estimates benchmarked against comparable mid-sized Italian tourist cities in peak July season.
